description: Where the 15.55 mm ArUco square sits inside each 58 mm face. Complements layout.json (face axes, sizes, IDs), which does not specify the in-face position.
offset_convention: marker_centre_cube = face_centre + offset[0] * marker_x_in_cube + offset[1] * marker_y_in_cube (layout.json axes); the same offset applies to all six faces
source: Pixel measurement of the six face labels in mbzuai_cube_with_aruco_preview.png (2026-11-24): cv2.aruco corners vs the face square, scale from the 58 mm face and from the 15.55 mm marker. All six faces: x +15.85..+16.04 mm, y -13.72..-13.88 mm; marker printed upright (OpenCV corner 0 = label top-left). The marker is NOT centred: it sits in the lower-right corner next to the letter, as also seen in the physical photos (evidence/hardware_frames).
physical_check: See docs/live_vision_digital_twin.md, 'Marker print layout'. Measure the marker-centre offset from the face centre on the real cube with calipers and set status to caliper_measured; until then poses carry this provenance.
recording_check: 2026-11-24, measured/layout_check_rgb.json (evidence/videos/rgb.mp4, 391 multi-face frames): the physical cube does NOT follow layout.json - blue U (ID 3) and white A (ID 4) are interchanged (B is opposite A, Z opposite U) and the M (ID 0) and I (ID 5) markers are rotated 180 deg. With the recording's axes, one shared offset of (+17.0, -12.2) mm fits at 0.56 px RMS (this preview value: 1.17 px). Candidate files: measured/layout.measured_rgb.json + measured/marker_print_layout.measured_rgb.json (unconfirmed; select explicitly).
